reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter all the time, so a sachet I can toss in my bag is the first version of this that fits how I live. At $24.99 for one box I would try it once, and the named lab report and the money-back offer make that low risk.
objection: It is still 2 capsules every day, and I am not great at remembering anything daily. If the box sits in my bag and I skip half the days, I paid $25 for nothing.
